name: CommonJS RxJS observable pattern scenario
description: CommonJS observable subscription pattern under SIMPLE

files.observable.js: function Observable(sub) { this.sub = sub; } Observable.prototype.subscribe = function(fn) { this.sub(fn); }; module.exports = Observable;
files.app.js: var Obs = require('./observable.js'); new Obs(function(next) { next(100); }).subscribe(function(v) { window['out'] = v; });
